# mailtrap_contact_list (Resource)

Manages a Mailtrap contact list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailtrap_contact_list" "example" {
  name = "Newsletter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the contact list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the contact list.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a contact list by its numeric ID.
terraform import mailtrap_contact_list.example 12345
```
